paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. The crowd wanted Jesus to tell them plainly, and He had. He says, "I already told you, but you did not believe" (John 10:25). The problem was never missing information, because they had the works right in front of them, and Jesus says those works "testify on My behalf" (John 10:25).

Now hear the part that gets me every time. Jesus says of His sheep, "I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand" (John 10:28). Then He adds, "No one can snatch them out of My Father's hand" (John 10:29). That's two hands, friend, and I spent YEARS in a junk drawer wishing I had even one hand holding on to me.

So what do we do with that? We listen, and we follow, because Jesus says, "My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me" (John 10:27). We can also believe the works, and Jesus says they show "that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father" (John 10:38). Across the Jordan, many people did just that, and "many in that place believed in Jesus" (John 10:42).
